thread:
Aya Tanaka: hi team! joining from JP this week. quick Q: who do I ping for badge access and local laptop provisioning? also curious about best practice for posting outside US hours so i don't disturb folks.

IT Support: welcome Aya! :wave: for badge access and local device shipping ping @IT Support. If you're in Japan include your office location (Tokyo/Osaka) and whether you need an external monitor. Example: 

IT Support: `@IT Support: Aya Tanaka, Tokyo office, monitor=yes, macOS`

IT Support: shipping usually takes 3-5 business days. We'll DM you a shipping form and an available time for the one-click VPN setup.

Security Bot: automated: FYI please complete the security orientation within 48 hrs. Run `security enroll` in DM to me to start.

Aya Tanaka: thanks! and about posting times — i'm UTC+9 and don't want to ping folks late. any channel-specific guidance?

Ricky M.: good question. guideline: avoid @here or @channel unless it's urgent or scheduled. For async questions post in #new-hires or the team channel and add "no-urgent" in the first line if you don't need an immediate reply. People tend to check messages in their morning and reply then.

Ricky M.: example: "no-urgent: can someone point me to the API quickstart?"

Onboarding Bot: Hi Aya :sparkles: I've queued the Day-1 checklist in your DMs. To opt out of daily tips DM me `unsubscribe`. To get pinned resources run `/pins #new-hires`.

Aya Tanaka: perfect — i'll add "no-urgent" when it's okay to wait. when i tag @IT Support should i include laptop serial or just ask first?

IT Support: just ask first. we'll ask for model/serial if we need to troubleshoot. also please upload a profile photo and timezone in Settings -> Profile so teammates know when to expect replies.

Aya Tanaka: will do. thanks all! :bow:
